author: Pinko Collective
title: Pinko no. 5
content:
Our latest magazine issue is about to be sent off to the printers for delivery by the end of the year. 

Pre-order yours now

 to secure a copy before they all sell out. 

This issue contains nearly 100 pages of new writing, photography, interviews, translations, and commemorations of elders in the gay communist tradition. It's a labor of love from us to the real movement which abolishes the present state of things. We hope you find in it what you desire. 

If you donated to our crowdfunding campaign at the level which receives one of these copies, don't worry — yours is reserved and will be shipped out with the first batch. If you haven't, pre-ordering now will make certain you get a copy. Some bookstores and other spaces will have a number of copies for sale, though we can't say for sure where yet. If you're interested in wholesaling, get in touch. 

Issue 5

Pinko’s fifth magazine issue. The only English-language print magazine of gay communism is now ready to purchase. Place your order now for delivery by the end of the year.
